about: The data jobs the daily Data health check watches (dev/data_health.py; rules in docs/DATA-UPDATES.md). max_age_hours: the longest time allowed since the job's last successful run; grace_hours: how long a source may stay failed before it is reported (0: at once). known_notes: notes from a job's log that are already known and listed in docs/ROADMAP.md, left out of the report. reviews: tasks done by hand on a cycle; after doing one, set its last_done to that date.
